cases.obligation: token mismatch -> probe false
cases.testSubstring: bad token, or a silent daemon

cases.obligation: heartbeat 15001 rejected / 14999 accepted
non-hello first frame -> false
stalled daemon resolves false at timeout, not before, not hanging
malformed/missing/dead-pid discovery -> false, no throw
probe lane not starved by 4+1 observation spawns
timed-out child holds slot until exit
live discovery -> zero gjc spawns at readiness
hello-OK but routing stalled/erroring -> unhealthy; routing OK -> healthy; wrong protocolVersion -> false
live-heartbeat but wedged router is retired and relaunched
structural URL validation incl. userinfo attack
fenced tail then status reconcile -> one onTerminal per batch
cases.testSubstring: invokes onTerminal for one batch at most once

cases.obligation: answer shipped on tail (gw-i-), gateway restart, reconcile -> no new ledger row
[BREAK] per-part terminal slots; regenerated DIFFERENT text posts nothing (real deliveryCreate)
id-less interim frames: distinct texts distinct ids, replayed text collides
tail-less reconcile never reposts previous turn (omitStartedAt, session-wide last_assistant)
failed-steer backlog: late-dispatched batch never inherits previous answer
schema 18 migration from a genuine v17 table: columns added, existing bound row untouched, first-bind floor, per-part claim, requeue clears
50035 from messages.fetch and from react -> ambiguous:false
non-permanent failure (429 exhausting retries) stays ambiguous:true
engagement.reaction rejection logs, never reconnects
chat.progress from tail only; no transcript.list/usage.get; one final frame
fresh-turn retry gets its own floor; failed attempt's row never reposted
pre-v18 bound batch without startedAt is held, never completed empty
wedged strikes scoped per daemon identity
strike attributed to the probed discovery record; mid-probe flip never charges the successor
